## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Output does not claim unverified execution or evidence
- [ ] No secret or sensitive data is committed
- [ ] Minimum necessary permissions are used
- [ ] Error and fallback behavior is safe
- [ ] Audit, cost and monitoring implications are covered
- [ ] Definition of Done is satisfied
